name: trip-angkut-api
description: Backend API for Aplikasi Trip Angkutan

scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=process.env.APK_DIR||'apks';console.log('APK_DIR:',p);try{fs.mkdirSync(p,{recursive:true})}catch(e){console.log('mkdir err:',e.message)}try{const f=p+'/app-1.0.4.apk';if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.log('APK not found at',f);const src='backend/apks/app-1.0.4.apk';if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,f);console.log('Copied APK to',f)}else{console.log('Source APK not found:',src)}}else{console.log('APK exists at',p)}if(fs.readdirSync(p).length)console.log('Files:',fs.readdirSync(p))}catch(e){console.log('Error:',e.message)}" && node src/index.js
